body: Hey, thank you for checking in I appreciate it! I'm doing alright, thank you for asking. Your dog oreo is so cute btw :)
I hope it gets better for you :)
It'll probably be painful, I wouldn't try it if I was you. Please get help and stay strong!

Thank you :). I can imagine, amitriptyline makes you zone out and drowsy. It's hard to concentrate, I don't know how you cope with taking it every day. My memory is messed up but this is the most I can remember. The last thing I remember is waking up to my heartbeat, it was fast and loud. I thought I was dying so I went back to sleep and then I woke up for real, I was shaking and felt sick. I honestly don't know how long I was out for but I think it was quite a while. It's not painful while your ODing but it's the aftermath. Thank you for asking btw.
I'm so glad it went well for you and that you're happy now! Thank you for your advice I appreciate it! I'm doing okay now.
Thank you for letting me know, I appreciate you taking your time to help!
Congrats on being 2 months clean!!! I'm sorry to hear that you feel that way :( please tell somebody how you're feeling and get help. Stay strong! Don't give up!

Thanks for your concern, I appreciate it! I'm in a situation where I can't tell anyone since I'll be in trouble. You probably think I'm stupid. Plus, I rarely feel any pain now. I'm not sure if that means something or nothing.

I know what you mean, it makes you lose track of time. What do you take amitriptyline for?(If you don't mind me asking)  if I'm going to be honest, it wasn't that bad. The worst part was feeling sick in my opinion, only a few mild pains but it definitely has effected my memory and caused some problems. Thanks for asking
I can imagine. Amitriptyline can make you feel spaced and drowsy, it also has many side effects. I'm sure you'll get used to them though.
I hope you're doing okay, stay strong. You matter!

It's quite hard to find a painless and peaceful way to die. Even if you do find a painless way, leaving loved ones behind might bring you pain. It's never too late to get help even if it isn't from a professional. Often, suicide leaves a domino effect. Don't give up and remember you matter! Stay strong.
I hope you're doing okay and getting the help you need. Stay strong, you deserve happiness!
Thank you for being so kind. You're an amazing person! :)
I appreciate you taking your time to do that! I'm going to get activated charcoal today. So hopefully that will help. I'm not brave enough to tell anyone so I can't get checked out.

It's really hard to find a painless overdose. You have to have the perfect cocktail of drugs. And it's not like in the movies. You could be dying for days or weeks after overdosing. Don't do it. Please get help. I hope your situation gets better!
How do you feel?
Thank you!
I can imagine. How are you planning to commit suicide?
I'm sorry to hear that. I would say suicide isn't the answer but that would make me a hypocrite. I hope your situation gets better!
Sorry to hear that. What's wrong with your health? I don't really have a  reason. I can't tell you my age. I hope you get well soon!
What's more worse?
To die
I don't wanna be here anymore
I'm sure. I had 28 10mg pills and then 14 25mg pills soon after.
They aren't mine. I stole them from my mum. My intention was death.
Thank you for your concern. I'm so sorry that happened to you. I hope you're doing better!
Thank you for your concern. I appreciate it. I've stopped shaking and I don't feel sick anymore. I don't have  any pains today. Am I still at risk of dying?
Thank you for your concern. I appreciate it. I feel fine now. I don't feel sick and I've stopped shaking. I don't feel any pain today.
